_comment: Verified upstream source for every LGPL/MPL component that GeoForge ships as a separate file, keyed by name and the exact version found in the build. collect_notices.py --strict fails when a shipped LGPL/MPL component has no entry here for its exact version. Every URL was downloaded or opened on 2026-10-21; where a sha256 is given, the download matched it (for conda-forge builds it is also the sha256 in the package's own recipe). Rust crates are not listed here: their source is the crates.io archive whose sha256 is recorded in Cargo.lock.
